identificationModule.briefTitle: Autologous Tumor Infiltrating Lymphocytes (GT101 Injection) in Patients With Recurrent or Metastatic Cervical Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase 2, Multicenter Randomized Controlled Open-label Study of Autologous Tumor Infiltrating Lymphocytes (GT101 Injection) in Patients With Recurrent or Metastatic Cervical Cancer

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is a Phase II, multicenter, open-label, randomized, parallel group, treatment study to assess the efficacy and safety of Autologous Tumor Infiltrating Lymphocytes (GT101 injection) compared with Gemcitabine in participants with recurrent or metastatic cervical cancer.

interventions.name: GT101 injection
interventions.description: GT101 injection to treat cervical cancer

interventions.name: Gemcitabine injection
interventions.description: Gemcitabine injection to treat cervical cancer

primaryOutcomes.description: Defined as time from first study treatment until disease progression or death from any cause, whichever occurs first.

secondaryOutcomes.description: Defined as the time from date of the first documentation of objective tumor response (CR or PR) to the first documentation of either Progression of Disease (PD) or death due to any cause, whichever occurs first.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Number of participants with treatment-related adverse events as assessed by CTCAE v5.0
secondaryOutcomes.description: Safety will be monitored by incidence, nature, and severity of treatment-emergent adverse events, including adverse drug reactions graded according to CTCAE version 5.0.
